Require Import strictness.cbpv.typing.

Require Export strictness.cbn.typing.

Fixpoint translateType {n} (T : CbnTy n) : CompTy n * attrs n :=
    match T with
    | TUnit => (CF VUnit, lazyvector)
    | TSum γ1' T1 γ2' T2 =>
        let '(A1, γ1) := translateType T1 in
        let '(A2, γ2) := translateType T2 in
        (CF (VSum (VThunk (γ1' γ+ γ1) A1) (VThunk (γ2' γ+ γ2) A2)), lazyvector)
    | TProd γ1 T1 γ2 T2 =>
        let '(A1, γ1') := translateType T1 in
        let '(A2, γ2') := translateType T2 in
        (CF (VProd (VThunk (γ1 γ+ γ1') A1) (VThunk (γ2 γ+ γ2') A2)), lazyvector)
    | TArrow γInput q γ T1 T2 =>
        let '(A, γ1') := translateType T1 in
        let '(B, γ2') := translateType T2 in
        (CAbs (q C+ γ2' None) (VThunk (γInput γ+ γ1') A) (down_ty B), γ γ+ (γ↓ γ2'))
    end.

Definition translateContext {n} (Γ : cbnContext n) : context n :=
    fun (i : fin n) =>
        let '(τ, γ) := (Γ i) in
        let '(B, γ') := translateType τ in
        VThunk (γ γ+ γ') B.

Fixpoint translateTerm {n} (e : Term n) : Comp n :=
    match e with
    | tVar i => cForce (vVar i)
    | tAbs e => cAbs (translateTerm e)
    | tApp e1 e2 =>
        cApp (translateTerm e1) (vThunk (translateTerm e2))
    | tLet t1 t2 =>
        cLet (cRet (vThunk (translateTerm t1))) (translateTerm t2)
    | tUnit => cRet vUnit
    | tSeq e1 e2 =>
        cLet
            (translateTerm e1)
            (cSeq (vVar var_zero) ((ren_Comp shift) (translateTerm e2)))
    | tPair e1 e2 =>
        cRet (vPair (vThunk (translateTerm e1)) (vThunk (translateTerm e2)))
    | tInl e => cRet (vInl (vThunk (translateTerm e)))
    | tInr e => cRet (vInr (vThunk (translateTerm e)))
    | tSplit e1 e2 =>
        cLet
            (translateTerm e1)
            (cSplit
                (vVar var_zero)
                ((ren_Comp up2_ren') (translateTerm e2)))
    | tCase e e1 e2 =>
        cLet (translateTerm e)
            (cCase (vVar var_zero)
                ((ren_Comp up_ren') (translateTerm e1))
                ((ren_Comp up_ren') (translateTerm e2)))
    | tSub e => cSub (translateTerm e)
    end.

Theorem translation_correct_returner :
    forall n (γ : attrs n) (Γ : cbnContext n) e T A γ',
    cbnWt γ Γ e T ->
    (CF A, γ') = translateType T ->
    CWt γ (translateContext Γ) (translateTerm e) (CF A).
---
# A dependency directory is named after its Rocq library (for example, Metalib).
LIBRARIES := $(wildcard .rocq-deps/*)
LIBRARY_FLAGS := $(foreach lib,$(LIBRARIES),-R $(lib) $(notdir $(lib)))

.PHONY: all clean
all: Makefile.coq
	$(MAKE) -f Makefile.coq

Makefile.coq: _CoqProject Makefile
	rocq makefile -f _CoqProject $(LIBRARY_FLAGS) -o Makefile.coq

clean:
	$(MAKE) -f Makefile.coq clean
---

Require Export strictness.cbn.syntax.

Require Export strictness.cbpv.typing.

Definition cbnContext n : Type := fin n -> CbnTy n * attrs n.

Definition cbnContext_insert {n} (T : CbnTy n) (γ : attrs n) (Γ : cbnContext n) : cbnContext (S n) :=
    (Lazy T↑ T, Lazy .: γ) .: (fun fn => let '(τ, γ) := Γ fn in (Lazy T↑ τ, Lazy .: γ)).

Inductive cbnWt {n} (γ : attrs n) (Γ : cbnContext n) : Term n -> CbnTy n -> Prop :=
  | CBN_T_Var i A γ' :
    (A, γ') = Γ i ->
    γ = (γ' <- Strict @ i) ->

    cbnWt γ Γ (tVar i) A

  | CBN_T_Unit :
    γ = lazyvector ->

    cbnWt γ Γ tUnit TUnit

  | CBN_T_Let q γ1 t1 t2 T1 T2 T :
    cbnWt γ1 Γ t1 T1 ->
    cbnWt (q .: γ) (cbnContext_insert T1 γ1 Γ) t2 T2 ->
    T = down_cbnTy T2 ->

    cbnWt γ Γ (tLet t1 t2) T

  | CBN_T_Pair γ1 γ2 t1 t2 T1 T2 :
    cbnWt γ1 Γ t1 T1 ->
    cbnWt γ2 Γ t2 T2 ->
    γ = lazyvector ->

    cbnWt γ Γ (tPair t1 t2) (TProd γ1 T1 γ2 T2)

  | CBN_T_Inl γ' γ'' t1 T1 T2 :
    cbnWt γ' Γ t1 T1 ->
    γ = lazyvector ->

    cbnWt γ Γ (tInl t1) (TSum γ' T1 γ'' T2)

  | CBN_T_Inr γ' γ'' t2 T1 T2 :
    cbnWt γ' Γ t2 T2 ->
    γ = lazyvector ->

    cbnWt γ Γ (tInr t2) (TSum γ'' T1 γ' T2)

  | CBN_T_Seq t1 t2 T γ1 γ2 :
    cbnWt γ1 Γ t1 TUnit ->
    cbnWt γ2 Γ t2 T ->
    γ = γ1 γ+ γ2 ->

    cbnWt γ Γ (tSeq t1 t2) T

  | CBN_T_Split t1 t2 q1 q2 γ1 γ2 γ1' γ2' T1 T2 T T':
    cbnWt γ1 Γ t1 (TProd γ1' T1 γ2' T2) ->
    cbnWt (q1 .: (q2 .: γ2))
      (cbnContext_insert (Lazy T↑ T1) (Lazy .: γ1') (cbnContext_insert T2 γ2' Γ)) t2 T' ->
    γ = γ1 γ+ γ2 ->
    T = down_cbnTy (down_cbnTy T') ->

    cbnWt γ Γ (tSplit t1 t2) T

  | CBN_T_Case t1 t2 t3 q1 q2 γ1 γ2 γ1' γ2' TL1 TR1 T T2 T3:
    cbnWt γ1 Γ t1 (TSum γ1' TL1 γ2' TR1) ->
    cbnWt (q1 .: γ2) (cbnContext_insert TL1 γ1' Γ) t2 T2 ->
    cbnWt (q2 .: γ2) (cbnContext_insert TR1 γ2' Γ) t3 T3 ->
    γ = γ1 γ+ γ2 ->
    T = down_cbnTy T2 ->
    T = down_cbnTy T3 ->

    cbnWt γ Γ (tCase t1 t2 t3) T

  | CBN_T_Abs q γInput γ' t T1 T2 :
    cbnWt (q .: γ') (cbnContext_insert T1 γInput Γ) t T2 ->
    γ = lazyvector ->

    cbnWt γ Γ (tAbs t) (TArrow γInput q γ' T1 T2)

  | CBN_T_App t1 t2 q γ1 γInput γ3 T1 T2 T2' :
    cbnWt γ1 Γ t1 (TArrow γInput q γ3 T1 T2') ->
    cbnWt γInput Γ t2 T1 ->
    γ = γ1 γ+ γ3 ->
    T2 = down_cbnTy T2' ->

    cbnWt γ Γ (tApp t1 t2) T2

  | CBN_T_Sub γ' t T :
    cbnWt γ' Γ t T ->
    γ γ<= γ' ->

    cbnWt γ Γ (tSub t) T
.
=====
Require Export strictness.cbpv.syntax.

Definition context n : Type := fin n -> ValTy n.

Definition ctx_insert {n} (A : ValTy n) (Γ : context n) : context (S n) :=
    (Lazy A↑ A) .: (fun fn => Lazy A↑ (Γ fn)).

Inductive VWt {n} (γ : attrs n) (Γ : context n) : Val n -> ValTy n -> Prop :=
  | T_Var i A :
    A = Γ i ->
    γ = (lazyvector <- Strict @ i) ->

    VWt γ Γ (vVar i) A

  | T_Unit :
    γ = lazyvector ->

    VWt γ Γ vUnit VUnit

  | T_Thunk γ' M B :
    CWt γ' Γ M B ->
    γ = lazyvector ->

    VWt γ Γ (vThunk M) (VThunk γ' B)

  | T_Pair γ1 γ2 V1 V2 A1 A2 :
    VWt γ1 Γ V1 A1 ->
    VWt γ2 Γ V2 A2 ->
    γ = γ1 γ+ γ2 ->

    VWt γ Γ (vPair V1 V2) (VProd A1 A2)

  | T_Inl V1 A1 A2 :
    VWt γ Γ V1 A1 ->

    VWt γ Γ (vInl V1) (VSum A1 A2)

  | T_Inr V2 A1 A2 :
    VWt γ Γ V2 A2 ->

    VWt γ Γ (vInr V2) (VSum A1 A2)

with CWt {n} (γ : attrs n) (Γ : context n) : Comp n -> CompTy n -> Prop :=
  | T_Ret V A :
    VWt γ Γ V A ->

    CWt γ Γ (cRet V) (CF A)

  | T_Let q M M' A B B' γ1 γ2:
    CWt γ1 Γ M (CF A) ->
    CWt (q .: γ2) (ctx_insert A Γ) M' B' ->
    γ = γ1 γ+ γ2 ->
    B = (down_compTy_until B' n (Nat.le_succ_diag_r n)) ->

    CWt γ Γ (cLet M M') B

  | T_Force V B γ1 γ2 :
    VWt γ1 Γ V (VThunk γ2 B) ->
    γ = γ1 γ+ γ2 ->

    CWt γ Γ (cForce V) B

  | T_Seq V M B γ1 γ2 :
    VWt γ1 Γ V VUnit ->
    CWt γ2 Γ M B ->
    γ = γ1 γ+ γ2 ->

    CWt γ Γ (cSeq V M) B

  | T_Split q1 q2 V M γ1 γ2 A1 A2 B B':
    VWt γ1 Γ V (VProd A1 A2) ->
    CWt (q1 .: (q2 .: γ2)) (ctx_insert (Lazy A↑ A1) (ctx_insert A2 Γ)) M B' ->
    γ = γ1 γ+ γ2 ->
    B = (down_compTy_until B' n (le_S n (S n) (Nat.le_succ_diag_r n))) ->

    CWt γ Γ (cSplit V M) B

  | T_Case q1 q2 V M1 M2 γ1 γ2 A1 A2 B B1 B2:
    VWt γ1 Γ V (VSum A1 A2) ->
    CWt (q1 .: γ2) (ctx_insert A1 Γ) M1 B1 ->
    CWt (q2 .: γ2) (ctx_insert A2 Γ) M2 B2 ->
    γ = γ1 γ+ γ2 ->
    B = (down_compTy_until B1 n (Nat.le_succ_diag_r n)) ->
    B = (down_compTy_until B2 n (Nat.le_succ_diag_r n)) ->

    CWt γ Γ (cCase V M1 M2) B

  | T_Abs q M A B B' :
    CWt (q .: γ) (ctx_insert A Γ) M B' ->
    B = (down_compTy_until B' n (Nat.le_succ_diag_r n)) ->

    CWt γ Γ (cAbs M) (CAbs q A B)

  | T_App M q V γ1 γ2 A B:
    CWt γ1 Γ M (CAbs q A B) ->
    VWt γ2 Γ V A ->
    γ = γ1 γ+ γ2 ->

    CWt γ Γ (cApp M V) B

  | T_CSub M γ' B:
    CWt γ' Γ M B ->
    γ γ<= γ' ->

    CWt γ Γ (cSub M) B
.

Scheme VWt_ind' := Induction for VWt Sort Prop
    with CWt_ind' := Induction for CWt Sort Prop.

Combined Scheme Wt_mutual from VWt_ind', CWt_ind'.

  | T_Unit :
    γ = lazyvector ->

    VWt γ Γ vUnit VUnit

  | T_Thunk γ' M B :
    CWt γ' Γ M B ->
    γ = lazyvector ->

    VWt γ Γ (vThunk M) (VThunk γ' B)

  | T_Pair γ1 γ2 V1 V2 A1 A2 :
    VWt γ1 Γ V1 A1 ->
    VWt γ2 Γ V2 A2 ->
    γ = γ1 γ+ γ2 ->

    VWt γ Γ (vPair V1 V2) (VProd A1 A2)

  | T_Inl V1 A1 A2 :
    VWt γ Γ V1 A1 ->

    VWt γ Γ (vInl V1) (VSum A1 A2)

  | T_Inr V2 A1 A2 :
    VWt γ Γ V2 A2 ->

    VWt γ Γ (vInr V2) (VSum A1 A2)

with CWt {n} (γ : attrs n) (Γ : context n) : Comp n -> CompTy n -> Prop :=
  | T_Ret V A :
    VWt γ Γ V A ->

    CWt γ Γ (cRet V) (CF A)

  | T_Let q M M' A B B' γ1 γ2:
    CWt γ1 Γ M (CF A) ->
    CWt (q .: γ2) (ctx_insert A Γ) M' B' ->
    γ = γ1 γ+ γ2 ->
    B = (down_compTy_until B' n (Nat.le_succ_diag_r n)) ->

    CWt γ Γ (cLet M M') B

  | T_Force V B γ1 γ2 :
    VWt γ1 Γ V (VThunk γ2 B) ->
    γ = γ1 γ+ γ2 ->

    CWt γ Γ (cForce V) B

  | T_Seq V M B γ1 γ2 :
    VWt γ1 Γ V VUnit ->
    CWt γ2 Γ M B ->
    γ = γ1 γ+ γ2 ->

    CWt γ Γ (cSeq V M) B

  | T_Split q1 q2 V M γ1 γ2 A1 A2 B B':
    VWt γ1 Γ V (VProd A1 A2) ->
    CWt (q1 .: (q2 .: γ2)) (ctx_insert (Lazy A↑ A1) (ctx_insert A2 Γ)) M B' ->
    γ = γ1 γ+ γ2 ->
    B = (down_compTy_until B' n (le_S n (S n) (Nat.le_succ_diag_r n))) ->

    CWt γ Γ (cSplit V M) B

  | T_Case q1 q2 V M1 M2 γ1 γ2 A1 A2 B B1 B2:
    VWt γ1 Γ V (VSum A1 A2) ->
    CWt (q1 .: γ2) (ctx_insert A1 Γ) M1 B1 ->
    CWt (q2 .: γ2) (ctx_insert A2 Γ) M2 B2 ->
    γ = γ1 γ+ γ2 ->
    B = (down_compTy_until B1 n (Nat.le_succ_diag_r n)) ->
    B = (down_compTy_until B2 n (Nat.le_succ_diag_r n)) ->

    CWt γ Γ (cCase V M1 M2) B

  | T_Abs q M A B B' :
    CWt (q .: γ) (ctx_insert A Γ) M B' ->
    B = (down_compTy_until B' n (Nat.le_succ_diag_r n)) ->

    CWt γ Γ (cAbs M) (CAbs q A B)

  | T_App M q V γ1 γ2 A B:
    CWt γ1 Γ M (CAbs q A B) ->
    VWt γ2 Γ V A ->
    γ = γ1 γ+ γ2 ->

    CWt γ Γ (cApp M V) B

  | T_CSub M γ' B:
    CWt γ' Γ M B ->
    γ γ<= γ' ->

    CWt γ Γ (cSub M) B
.

Scheme VWt_ind' := Induction for VWt Sort Prop
    with CWt_ind' := Induction for CWt Sort Prop.

Combined Scheme Wt_mutual from VWt_ind', CWt_ind'.

    match s return Val n with

    | vUnit => vUnit

    match s return Comp n with

    | cApp s0 s1 => cApp (ren_Comp ξ s0) (ren_Val ξ s1)
    | cForce s0 => cForce (ren_Val ξ s0)
    | cSplit s1 s2 => cSplit (ren_Val ξ s1)

    | cRet s1 => cRet (ren_Val ξ s1)
    | cLet s1 s2 => cLet (ren_Comp ξ s1) (ren_Comp (upRen_Val_Val ξ) s2)

        (ren_Comp (upRen_Val_Val ξ) s2)
        (ren_Comp (upRen_Val_Val ξ) s3)
    | cSub s1 => cSub (ren_Comp ξ s1)
    end.

Require Export strictness.autosubst2.axioms.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Unset Strict Implicit.

Definition ap {X Y} (f : X -> Y) {x y : X} (p : x = y) : f x = f y :=
  match p with eq_refl => eq_refl end.

Definition apc {X Y} {f g : X -> Y} {x y : X} (p : f = g) (q : x = y) : f x = g y :=
  match q with eq_refl => match p with eq_refl => eq_refl end end.

Fixpoint fin (n : nat) : Set :=
  match n with
  | 0 => False
  | S m => option (fin m)
  end.

Definition ren (m n : nat) : Type := fin m -> fin n.

Definition id {X} (x : X) := x.

Definition idren {k: nat} : ren k k :=
  fun x => x.

Definition var_zero {n : nat} : fin (S n) := None.

Definition null {T} (i : fin 0) : T := match i with end.

Definition shift {n : nat} : ren n (S n) :=
  Some.

Definition comp := @funcomp.

Definition scons {X : Type} {n : nat} (x : X) (f : fin n -> X) (m : fin (S n)) : X :=
  match m with
  | None => x
  | Some i => f i
  end.

Class Ren1 (X1  : Type) (Y Z : Type) :=
  ren1 : X1 -> Y -> Z.

Class Ren2 (X1 X2 : Type) (Y Z : Type) :=
  ren2 : X1 -> X2 -> Y -> Z.

Class Ren3 (X1 X2 X3 : Type) (Y Z : Type) :=
  ren3 : X1 -> X2 -> X3 -> Y -> Z.

Class Ren4 (X1 X2 X3 X4 : Type) (Y Z : Type) :=
  ren4 : X1 -> X2 -> X3 -> X4 -> Y -> Z.

Class Ren5 (X1 X2 X3 X4 X5 : Type) (Y Z : Type) :=
  ren5 : X1 -> X2 -> X3 -> X4 -> X5 -> Y -> Z.

Declare Scope fscope.

Declare Scope subst_scope.

Notation "s ⟨ xi1 ⟩" := (ren1  xi1 s) (at level 7, left associativity, format "s  ⟨ xi1 ⟩") : subst_scope.

Notation "s ⟨ xi1 ; xi2 ⟩" := (ren2 xi1 xi2 s) (at level 7, left associativity, format "s  ⟨ xi1 ; xi2 ⟩") : subst_scope.

Notation "s ⟨ xi1 ; xi2 ; xi3 ⟩" := (ren3 xi1 xi2 xi3 s) (at level 7, left associativity, format "s  ⟨ xi1 ; xi2 ; xi3 ⟩") : subst_scope.

Notation "s ⟨ xi1 ; xi2 ; xi3 ; xi4 ⟩" := (ren4  xi1 xi2 xi3 xi4 s) (at level 7, left associativity, format "s  ⟨ xi1 ; xi2 ; xi3 ; xi4 ⟩") : subst_scope.

Notation "s ⟨ xi1 ; xi2 ; xi3 ; xi4 ; xi5 ⟩" := (ren5  xi1 xi2 xi3 xi4 xi5 s) (at level 7, left associativity, format "s  ⟨ xi1 ; xi2 ; xi3 ; xi4 ; xi5 ⟩") : subst_scope.

Notation "⟨ xi ⟩" := (ren1 xi) (at level 1, left associativity, format "⟨ xi ⟩") : fscope.

Notation "⟨ xi1 ; xi2 ⟩" := (ren2 xi1 xi2) (at level 1, left associativity, format "⟨ xi1 ; xi2 ⟩") : fscope.

Class Subst1 (X1 : Type) (Y Z: Type) :=
  subst1 : X1 -> Y -> Z.

Class Subst2 (X1 X2 : Type) (Y Z: Type) :=
  subst2 : X1 -> X2 -> Y  -> Z.

Class Subst3 (X1 X2 X3 : Type) (Y Z: Type) :=
  subst3 : X1 -> X2 -> X3 ->  Y  -> Z.

Class Subst4 (X1 X2 X3 X4: Type) (Y Z: Type) :=
  subst4 : X1 -> X2 -> X3 -> X4 -> Y  -> Z.

Class Subst5 (X1 X2 X3 X4 X5 : Type) (Y Z: Type) :=
  subst5 : X1 -> X2 -> X3 -> X4 -> X5  -> Y  -> Z.

Notation "s [ sigma ]" := (subst1 sigma s) (at level 7, left associativity, format "s '/' [ sigma ]") : subst_scope.

Notation "s [ sigma ; tau ]" := (subst2 sigma tau s) (at level 7, left associativity, format "s '/' [ sigma ; '/'  tau ]") : subst_scope.

Class Var X Y :=
  ids : X -> Y.

Arguments funcomp {X Y Z} (g) (f).

Require Export strictness.autosubst2.axioms.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Unset Strict Implicit.

Definition ap {X Y} (f : X -> Y) {x y : X} (p : x = y) : f x = f y :=
  match p with eq_refl => eq_refl end.

Definition apc {X Y} {f g : X -> Y} {x y : X} (p : f = g) (q : x = y) : f x = g y :=
  match q with eq_refl => match p with eq_refl => eq_refl end end.

Fixpoint fin (n : nat) : Set :=
  match n with
  | 0 => False
  | S m => option (fin m)
  end.

Definition ren (m n : nat) : Type := fin m -> fin n.

Definition id {X} (x : X) := x.

Definition idren {k: nat} : ren k k :=
  fun x => x.

Definition var_zero {n : nat} : fin (S n) := None.

Definition null {T} (i : fin 0) : T := match i with end.

Definition shift {n : nat} : ren n (S n) :=
  Some.

Definition comp := @funcomp.

Definition scons {X : Type} {n : nat} (x : X) (f : fin n -> X) (m : fin (S n)) : X :=
  match m with
  | None => x
  | Some i => f i
  end.

Require Import strictness.cbpv.typing.
Require Export strictness.cbn.typing.
From Stdlib Require Import Logic.FunctionalExtensionality.
From Stdlib Require Import Logic.Eqdep_dec.
From Stdlib Require Import Arith PeanoNat.

(* ---------- index & attribute insertion machinery ---------- *)
Fixpoint ins_ren (k : nat) {m} (i : fin m) {struct k} : fin (S m) :=
  match k with
  | 0 => Some i
  | S k' => match m as mm return fin mm -> fin (S mm) with
            | 0 => fun i => match i with end
            | S m' => fun i => match i with
                               | None => None
                               | Some j => Some (@ins_ren k' m' j)
                               end
            end i
  end.

Fixpoint ins_at (k : nat) {m} (γ : attrs m) {struct k} : attrs (S m) :=
  match k with
  | 0 => fun i => match i with None => Lazy | Some j => γ j end
  | S k' => match m as mm return attrs mm -> attrs (S mm) with
            | 0 => fun _ => fun _ => Lazy
            | S m' => fun δ => fun i => match i with
                                        | None => δ None
                                        | Some j => @ins_at k' m' (fun x => δ (Some x)) j
                                        end
            end γ
  end.

Definition dummy (b : nat) {m} : fin (S m) :=
  match b with
  | 0 => None
  | S b' => match m as mm return fin (S mm) with
            | 0 => None
            | S m' => Some (@dummy b' m')
            end
  end.

Lemma ins_ren_inj : forall b m (i j : fin m), @ins_ren b m i = @ins_ren b m j -> i = j.
Proof.
  induction b as [|b IH]; intros m i j H.
  - destruct m as [|m']; [destruct i|]. simpl in H. injection H as H. f_equal. exact H.
  - destruct m as [|m']; [destruct i|]. simpl in H.
    destruct i as [i'|], j as [j'|].
    + simpl in H. injection H as H. assert (i' = j') as -> by (apply IH; exact H). reflexivity.
    + simpl in H. discriminate.
    + simpl in H. discriminate.
    + reflexivity.
Qed.
Arguments ins_ren_inj {b m i j} _.

Lemma ins_ren_none : forall b m, @ins_ren b (S m) None = None.
Proof.
  induction b; intros m; simpl; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ins_ren_some : forall b m (i : fin m), @ins_ren b (S m) (Some i) = Some (@ins_ren b m i).
Proof.
  induction b; intros m i; simpl; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma up_ren_ins_ren : forall b m, @up_ren m (S m) (@ins_ren b m) = @ins_ren (S b) m.
Proof.
  intros b m. apply functional_extensionality. intros i.
  destruct i as [i'|].
  - rewrite ins_ren_none. unfold up_ren. simpl. reflexivity.
  - rewrite ins_ren_some. unfold up_ren. simpl.
    rewrite ins_ren_some. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma up2_ren_ins_ren : forall b m, @up_ren (S m) (S (S m)) (@up_ren m (S m) (@ins_ren b m)) = @ins_ren (S (S b)) m.
Proof.
  intros b m. rewrite up_ren_ins_ren.
  apply functional_extensionality. intros i.
  destruct i as [i'|].
  - rewrite ins_ren_none. unfold up_ren. simpl. reflexivity.
  - rewrite ins_ren_some. unfold up_ren. simpl.
    rewrite ins_ren_some. reflexivity.
Qed.
EOF

(* ---------- individual renaming lemmas ---------- *)
Definition VWt_ins_gen := fun (b n : nat) (γ : attrs n) (Γ : context n) (V : Val n) (A : ValTy n)
  (h : VWt γ Γ V A) (Δ : context (S n))
  (Hc : forall i : fin n, Δ (ins_ren b i) = ins_ty b n (Γ i)) =>
  proj1 (Wt_ins_mutual n γ Γ) V A h b Δ Hc.

Definition CWt_ins_gen := fun (b n : nat) (γ : attrs n) (Γ : context n) (M : Comp n) (B : CompTy n)
  (h : CWt γ Γ M B) (Δ : context (S n))
  (Hc : forall i : fin n, Δ (ins_ren b i) = ins_ty b n (Γ i)) =>
  proj2 (Wt_ins_mutual n γ Γ) M B h b Δ Hc.

(* ---------- attribute helper lemmas ---------- *)
Lemma lazyvector_add : forall n, (@lazyvector n) γ+ (@lazyvector n) = @lazyvector n.
Proof.
  intros n. apply functional_extensionality. intros i. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma lazy_add : forall n (δ : attrs n), (@lazyvector n) γ+ δ = δ.
Proof.
  intros n δ. apply functional_extensionality. intros i. destruct (δ i); reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma add_lazy : forall n (δ : attrs n), δ γ+ (@lazyvector n) = δ.
Proof.
  intros n δ. apply functional_extensionality. intros i. destruct (δ i); reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma env_set_add : forall n (δ1 δ2 : attrs n) (i : fin n),
  ((δ1 γ+ δ2) <- Strict @ i) = (δ1 <- Strict @ i) γ+ δ2.
Proof.
  intros n δ1 δ2 i. apply functional_extensionality. intros j.
  unfold env_set. destruct (fin_eqb i j); simpl.
  - destruct (δ2 j); reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma lazy_env_set_add : forall n (δ : attrs n) (i : fin n),
  ((@lazyvector n) <- Strict @ i) γ+ δ = (δ <- Strict @ i).
Proof.
  intros n δ i. apply functional_extensionality. intros j.
  unfold env_set. destruct (fin_eqb i j); simpl.
  - destruct (δ j); reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma cons_add_r : forall q n (a : attrs n) (b : attrs (S n)),
  (q .: a) γ+ b = (q C+ b None) .: (a γ+ @down_attrs n b).
Proof.
  intros q n a b. apply functional_extensionality. intros j.
  destruct j as [j|]; simpl; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma attr_add_le : forall c1 c2 a, c1 C<= c2 -> c1 C+ a C<= c2 C+ a.
Proof.
  intros c1 c2 a H. destruct c1, c2, a; simpl in *; auto; try contradiction.
Qed.

Lemma attrs_add_le : forall n (γ1 γ2 δ : attrs n), γ1 γ<= γ2 -> (γ1 γ+ δ) γ<= (γ2 γ+ δ).
Proof. intros n γ1 γ2 δ H i. apply attr_add_le. apply H. Qed.

Lemma translateType_down : forall n (T : CbnTy (S n)),
  fst (translateType (down_cbnTy T)) = down_ty (fst (translateType T)) /\
  snd (translateType (down_cbnTy T)) = down_attrs (snd (translateType T)).
Proof.
  intros n T. apply translateType_ren_cbnTy.
Qed.

(* ---------- term translation ---------- *)
Fixpoint translateTerm {n} (e : Term n) : Comp n :=
    match e with
    | tVar i => cForce (vVar i)
    | tAbs e => cAbs (translateTerm e)
    | tApp e1 e2 =>
        cApp (translateTerm e1) (vThunk (translateTerm e2))
    | tLet t1 t2 =>
        cLet (cRet (vThunk (translateTerm t1))) (translateTerm t2)
    | tUnit => cRet vUnit
    | tSeq e1 e2 =>
        cLet
            (translateTerm e1)
            (cSeq (vVar var_zero) ((ren_Comp shift) (translateTerm e2)))
    | tPair e1 e2 =>
        cRet (vPair (vThunk (translateTerm e1)) (vThunk (translateTerm e2)))
    | tInl e => cRet (vInl (vThunk (translateTerm e)))
    | tInr e => cRet (vInr (vThunk (translateTerm e)))
    | tSplit e1 e2 =>
        cLet
            (translateTerm e1)
            (cSplit
                (vVar var_zero)
                ((ren_Comp up2_ren') (translateTerm e2)))
    | tCase e e1 e2 =>
        cLet (translateTerm e)
            (cCase (vVar var_zero)
                ((ren_Comp up_ren') (translateTerm e1))
                ((ren_Comp up_ren') (translateTerm e2)))
    | tSub e => cSub (translateTerm e)
    end.
